killedBy: driver: the developer single-tick step (issue #253) advances exactly one tick from one sample, and renders it whole with effects frozen
why: The stepped frame renders the PREVIOUS pose (alpha 0) instead of the new one. The world advanced, the HUD updated, and the board on screen still shows the tick before -- so a developer stepping to watch one tick sees every change one press late, which is the thing a single-tick control exists to show.
